text:
```yaml
name: Copilot Setup Steps

on:
  copilot-setup-steps:

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  setup:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup Rust toolchain
        uses: oxc-project/setup-rust@v1
        with:
          rust-version: 1.88.0

      - name: Setup Node.js and pnpm
        uses: oxc-project/setup-node@8958a8e040102244b619c4a94fccb657a44b1c21
        with:
          node-version: 22.14.0
          pnpm-version: 10.13.1

      - name: Install just
        uses: extractions/setup-just@v3
        with:
          just-version: 1.34.0

      - name: Install cargo-binstall
        run: cargo install cargo-binstall --locked

      - name: Install development tools
        run: just init

      - name: Install Node.js dependencies
        run: pnpm install

      - name: Verify tool installations
        run: |
          echo "=== Tool Versions ==="
          rustc --version
          cargo --version
          node --version
          pnpm --version
          just --version
          cargo binstall --version
          watchexec --version
          cargo insta --version
          typos --version
          cargo shear --version
          dprint --version

      - name: Verify build environment
        run: cargo check

      - name: Completion message
        run: |
          echo "=== Copilot Environment Setup Complete ==="
          echo "Available commands:"
          echo "- just ready    : Run all project checks"
          echo "- just fmt      : Format code"
          echo "- just test     : Run tests"
          echo "- just lint     : Run linters"
          echo ""
          echo "Environment is ready for Copilot agent usage."
```
